A '''skirmish''' in the [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[Cave/Legends|caves]] of a [[Sedrian village]] occurred in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. A team of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] hired by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Sprax]] to track down a stolen [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] from the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Limna Yith]] had subdued her and taken her to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]; after teaming up with [[Sedrian]] [[warrior monk]]s, they made their way to the caves, where she had earlier hidden the datacard.

Also en route to the caves was a team of mercenaries hired by Black Sun Vigo [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] to get the datacard. The team arrived first and [[Death/Legends|massacred]] the village before searching the caves, and when Sprax's team later arrived, they were attacked by four surviving villagers. Xizor's team then attacked Sprax's team but was defeated.
